$description: Wave 4 (W4 Web Overlays, D-018) component tokens for Popover. Aliases semantic/* only (never primitive/* directly, ds-conventions 3-layer rule). This is the reference 'floating panel' shape reused verbatim by Tooltip's larger sibling Dialog/Drawer (Reuse Check, D-018): bg = `color.surface.overlay` (brightest step of the D-008 elevation ladder — the panel reads as the topmost surface), border = `color.border.hairline` (braun-flat rule 1 still applies to the panel's own edge definition even though the panel itself is a permitted shadow layer — shadow communicates 'floating above the page', hairline communicates 'where the panel ends'), shadow = `shadow.elevation.md` (braun-flat rule 2 explicitly allows elevation shadow for popover; md sits between Tooltip's none and Dialog's lg because a popover floats less dramatically than a full modal). Contrast self-check (light/dark): text.default on surface.overlay = 14.85:1 / 11.11:1, border.hairline on surface.overlay = 1.48:1 light (expected — hairline is a quiet divider, not a 3:1-required interactive boundary per D-014 precedent for non-interactive edges) but the panel's OWN outer boundary against the page behind it is guaranteed visible by the shadow + surface-lightness jump, not the hairline alone.
